rules.response_en:
🌵 DROUGHT STRESS DETECTED:

Symptoms: Leaf rolling, afternoon wilting, stunted growth, yellowing

✅ IMMEDIATE:
• Irrigate within 24 hours (life-saving irrigation)
• Reduce fertilizer application by 25%
• Apply mulch to conserve moisture
• Spray KCl 1% for stress tolerance

📊 Yield impact: 5-7% loss per day of stress during grand growth

⚠️ After recovery: Resume normal schedule gradually
rules.response_hi:
🌵 सूखा तनाव:

लक्षण: पत्ती मुड़ना, मुरझाना, वाढ कमी

✅ तुरंत सिंचाई करें, 1% KCl छिड़कें
rules.response_mr:
🌵 दुष्काळ ताण:

लक्षणे: पान गुंडाळणे, कोमेजणे, वाढ कमी

✅ तात्काळ पाणी द्या, 1% KCl फवारा

rules.response_en:
🌡️ HEAT STRESS (Temperature >40°C):

Symptoms: Leaf scorching, tip burn, reduced photosynthesis, poor tillering

✅ MANAGEMENT:
• Increase irrigation frequency (5-7 day interval)
• Apply trash mulch to cool soil
• Spray 2% Kaolin (reflective coating)
• Avoid fertilizer during peak heat
• Light irrigation in evening cools crop

📊 Optimum: 30-35°C, Growth stops above 45°C
rules.response_hi:
🌡️ गर्मी तनाव (तापमान >40°C):

लक्षण: पत्ती झुलसना, सिरा जलना

✅ सिंचाई बढ़ाएं, मल्चिंग करें, 2% केओलिन छिड़कें
rules.response_mr:
🌡️ उष्णता ताण (तापमान >40°C):

लक्षणे: पान करपणे, टोक जळणे

✅ पाणी वाढवा, आच्छादन करा, 2% केओलिन फवारा

rules.response_en:
❄️ COLD STRESS (Temperature <15°C):

Symptoms: Yellowing (chlorosis), poor germination, stunted growth, leaf tip necrosis

✅ MANAGEMENT:
• Apply irrigation before cold night (soil stores heat)
• Trash mulch retains soil warmth
• Avoid nitrogen application during cold
• Spray 0.5% ZnSO4 + 0.3% Boric acid
• Light smoke/bonfire on coldest nights (traditional)

📊 Germination stops below 12°C, frost damages leaves
rules.response_hi:
❄️ ठंड तनाव (तापमान <15°C):

लक्षण: पीलापन, खराब अंकुरण

✅ ठंडी रात से पहले सिंचाई, मल्चिंग करें
rules.response_mr:
❄️ थंडी ताण (तापमान <15°C):

लक्षणे: पिवळेपणा, खराब उगवण

✅ थंड रात्रीपूर्वी पाणी, आच्छादन करा

rules.response_en:
🥶 FROST DAMAGE:

Symptoms: White/water-soaked leaves, rapid wilting after sunrise, stem splitting

✅ IMMEDIATE AFTER FROST:
• DO NOT touch frozen leaves (breaks cells)
• Wait for natural thawing
• Irrigate next day to raise soil temperature
• Cut severely damaged canes for early harvest
• Apply 1% Urea spray after recovery

⚠️ Sucrose inversion starts within 24 hours of frost
⚠️ Harvest frost-damaged cane within 7-10 days
rules.response_hi:
🥶 पाला नुकसान:

✅ जमी पत्तियों को न छुएं, अगले दिन सिंचाई करें
⚠️ 7-10 दिनों में कटाई करें
rules.response_mr:
🥶 दव नुकसान:

✅ गोठलेल्या पानांना स्पर्श करू नका, दुसऱ्या दिवशी पाणी द्या
⚠️ 7-10 दिवसांत कापणी करा

rules.response_en:
🌊 WATERLOGGING STRESS:

Symptoms: Yellowing, root rot, wilting despite wet soil, fungal growth

✅ IMMEDIATE:
• Drain excess water (open furrow outlets, pumping)
• After drainage: Spray Carbendazim 1g/L
• Apply Potash 20 kg/ha to strengthen
• Earthing up improves aeration

📊 Tolerance: 48-72 hours
📊 Beyond 5 days: 30-40% yield loss

⚠️ Ratoon more susceptible than plant crop
rules.response_hi:
🌊 जलभराव तनाव:

✅ तुरंत पानी निकालें, निकासी के बाद कार्बेन्डाजिम छिड़कें
⚠️ 5 दिनों से अधिक: 30-40% उपज हानि
rules.response_mr:
🌊 पाणी साचण्याचा ताण:

✅ तात्काळ पाणी काढा, निचऱ्यानंतर कार्बेन्डाझिम फवारा
⚠️ 5 दिवसांपेक्षा जास्त: 30-40% उत्पादन घट

rules.response_en:
🧂 SALT STRESS:

Symptoms: Leaf tip/margin burn, stunted growth, poor tillering, whitish deposits

✅ MANAGEMENT:
• Apply Gypsum @5-10 t/ha
• Leaching irrigation (20-25% extra water)
• Apply FYM/organic matter liberally
• Use tolerant varieties (Co 0238, CoS 767)
• Avoid chloride fertilizers (use SOP not MOP)

📊 Sugarcane tolerance: EC up to 4 dS/m
📊 Above 8 dS/m: Severe yield reduction
rules.response_hi:
🧂 लवण तनाव:

✅ जिप्सम @5-10 t/ha, लीचिंग सिंचाई
📊 सहनशीलता: EC 4 dS/m तक
rules.response_mr:
🧂 क्षार ताण:

✅ जिप्सम @5-10 t/ha, लीचिंग सिंचन
📊 सहनशीलता: EC 4 dS/m पर्यंत

rules.response_en:
💨 WIND/STORM DAMAGE:

Symptoms: Lodging (fallen canes), broken tops, uprooting

✅ AFTER STORM:
• Prop up fallen canes within 48 hours
• Tie in bundles if severely lodged
• Apply 25 kg N/ha to recover
• Spray fungicide (damaged canes prone to infection)
• Harvest severely damaged canes early

📋 PREVENTION:
• Earthing up strengthens root anchorage
• Propping in exposed areas
• Windbreaks (trees on field border)
rules.response_hi:
💨 तूफान नुकसान:

✅ 48 घंटे में गिरे गन्नों को उठाएं, गंभीर हो तो जल्दी काटें
📋 रोकथाम: मिट्टी चढ़ाना, प्रॉपिंग
rules.response_mr:
💨 वादळ नुकसान:

✅ 48 तासांत पडलेले ऊस उभे करा, गंभीर असल्यास लवकर कापा
📋 प्रतिबंध: मातीची भर, प्रॉपिंग

rules.response_en:
📉 LODGING MANAGEMENT:

Causes: Excess nitrogen, weak roots, waterlogging, wind, tall varieties

✅ PREVENTION:
• Balanced fertilization (don't excess N)
• Adequate potash (strengthens stalks)
• Timely earthing up (2-3 times)
• Proper drainage
• Variety selection (erect types)

✅ IF LODGED:
• Prop up within 48 hours
• Tie in groups of 4-5 canes
• Harvest lodged portion first

📊 Lodging reduces sugar by 1-2%
rules.response_hi:
📉 गिरने (लॉजिंग) प्रबंधन:

✅ रोकथाम: संतुलित उर्वरक, मिट्टी चढ़ाना, जल निकासी
✅ गिरने पर: 48 घंटे में उठाएं, बांधें
rules.response_mr:
📉 पडणे (लॉजिंग) व्यवस्थापन:

✅ प्रतिबंध: संतुलित खत, मातीची भर, निचरा
✅ पडल्यास: 48 तासांत उभे करा, बांधा

rules.response_en:
🧊 HAIL DAMAGE:

Symptoms: Shredded leaves, bruised/cracked stalks, broken growing points

✅ AFTER HAIL:
• Spray Carbendazim 1g/L + Streptocycline 0.5g/L (prevent infection)
• Apply 25 kg N/ha for recovery
• Cut severely damaged leaves (not stalks)
• If growing point dead: Side tillers will compensate

📋 INSURANCE: Report damage within 48 hours to insurance company

📊 Mild hail: 10-20% yield loss
📊 Severe hail: 30-50% yield loss
rules.response_hi:
🧊 ओलावृष्टि नुकसान:

✅ कार्बेन्डाजिम + स्ट्रेप्टोसाइक्लिन छिड़कें
✅ 25 kg N/ha दें, बीमा को 48 घंटे में रिपोर्ट करें
rules.response_mr:
🧊 गारपीट नुकसान:

✅ कार्बेन्डाझिम + स्ट्रेप्टोसायक्लिन फवारा
✅ 25 kg N/ha द्या, विम्याला 48 तासांत कळवा

rules.response_en:
🧪 NUTRIENT STRESS DIAGNOSIS:

📋 QUICK GUIDE:
• N deficiency: Yellowing from OLD leaves
• P deficiency: Purple leaves, poor roots
• K deficiency: Leaf margin burn, weak stalks
• Fe deficiency: Yellowing of YOUNG leaves (green veins)
• Zn deficiency: White bands on leaves

✅ ACTION:
• Conduct soil test if persistent
• Foliar spray for quick correction
• See detailed nutrient rules for specific treatment

⚠️ Overuse of one nutrient can induce deficiency of another
rules.response_hi:
🧪 पोषक तनाव निदान:

📋 N कमी: पुरानी पत्तियां पीली
📋 K कमी: पत्ती किनारा जलना
✅ मिट्टी परीक्षण करें, पर्णीय छिड़काव
rules.response_mr:
🧪 पोषक ताण निदान:

📋 N कमी: जुनी पाने पिवळी
📋 K कमी: पानाची कड करपणे
✅ माती परीक्षण करा, पर्णसंवर्धन फवारा

rules.response_en:
⚠️ TOXICITY SYMPTOMS:

📋 BORON TOXICITY: Leaf tip necrosis, brown spots
📋 SALT TOXICITY: White crust on soil, margin burn
📋 HERBICIDE TOXICITY: Abnormal growth, chlorosis
📋 EXCESS NITROGEN: Dark green, weak stalks, lodging

✅ MANAGEMENT:
• Heavy irrigation to leach excess
• Apply organic matter to buffer
• Foliar Ca spray for B toxicity
• Stop fertilizer application if excess

⚠️ Toxicity often mimics deficiency - soil test essential
rules.response_hi:
⚠️ विषाक्तता लक्षण:

📋 बोरॉन: पत्ती सिरा मृत
📋 नमक: सफेद परत, किनारा जलना
✅ भारी सिंचाई, जैविक पदार्थ डालें
rules.response_mr:
⚠️ विषाक्तता लक्षणे:

📋 बोरॉन: पान टोक मृत
📋 मीठ: पांढरा थर, कडा करपणे
✅ जास्त पाणी, सेंद्रिय पदार्थ टाका

rules.response_en:
🌱 RATOON STRESS:

Symptoms: Poor sprouting, uneven regrowth, weak tillers

✅ PREVENTION:
• Stubble shaving within 7 days of harvest
• First irrigation within 7 days (CRITICAL)
• Gap filling within 30 days
• Higher fertilizer dose (25% more than plant)
• Apply Carbendazim drench to cut stumps

📋 CAUSES OF FAILURE:
• Delayed irrigation (most common)
• Deep cutting (root damage)
• Pest/disease carryover
• Exhausted soil
rules.response_hi:
🌱 रैटून तनाव:

✅ 7 दिनों में ठूंठ छंटाई, 7 दिनों में पहली सिंचाई
📋 विफलता कारण: देरी से सिंचाई, गहरी कटाई
rules.response_mr:
🌱 खोडवा ताण:

✅ 7 दिवसांत खुंट छाटणी, 7 दिवसांत पहिले पाणी
📋 अपयश कारण: उशीरा पाणी, खोल कापणी

rules.response_en:
⚠️ MULTIPLE STRESS DETECTION:

When symptoms are confusing (multiple causes possible):

📋 DIAGNOSTIC APPROACH:
1. Check weather data (drought? heat? cold?)
2. Check irrigation history
3. Check fertilizer application record
4. Examine roots (rot? insects?)
5. Soil test if persistent
6. Send sample to lab if unsure

✅ GENERAL RECOVERY:
• Irrigate if soil dry
• Light N application (12.5 kg/ha)
• Foliar spray: 2% Urea + 1% KCl + micronutrients
• Address primary stress first
rules.response_hi:
⚠️ बहु तनाव:

📋 निदान: मौसम, सिंचाई, उर्वरक इतिहास जांचें
✅ सामान्य: सिंचाई, हल्का N, पर्णीय छिड़काव
rules.response_mr:
⚠️ बहु ताण:

📋 निदान: हवामान, सिंचन, खत इतिहास तपासा
✅ सामान्य: पाणी, हलके N, पर्णसंवर्धन फवारा

rules.response_en:
🍯 PRE-HARVEST STRESS FOR SUGAR ACCUMULATION:

✅ BENEFICIAL MILD STRESS:
• Stop irrigation 15-20 days before harvest
• Mild water stress increases sucrose concentration
• Reduces vegetative growth, promotes ripening

⚠️ AVOID:
• Severe drought (causes sucrose inversion)
• Frost (rapid sugar loss)
• Lodging (quality deterioration)

📊 Optimum harvest: When Brix >18 and Pol >16
rules.response_hi:
🍯 कटाई पूर्व तनाव:

✅ लाभदायक: कटाई से 15-20 दिन पहले सिंचाई बंद
📊 इष्टतम कटाई: Brix >18, Pol >16
rules.response_mr:
🍯 कापणीपूर्व ताण:

✅ फायदेशीर: कापणीपूर्वी 15-20 दिवस पाणी बंद
📊 इष्टतम कापणी: Brix >18, Pol >16

rules.response_en:
🔄 STRESS RECOVERY PROTOCOL:

✅ IMMEDIATE (Day 1-3):
• Address primary cause (irrigate/drain/protect)
• Light foliar spray if leaves functional

✅ SHORT TERM (Week 1-2):
• Resume normal irrigation
• Light N application (12.5-25 kg/ha)
• Spray micronutrient mix

✅ MEDIUM TERM (Week 3-4):
• Full fertilizer schedule if recovered
• Monitor for secondary issues (pests/diseases)
• Assess damage for insurance if needed

⚠️ Don't over-fertilize stressed plants - they can't utilize
rules.response_hi:
🔄 तनाव रिकवरी:

✅ तुरंत: कारण ठीक करें
✅ 1-2 सप्ताह: सामान्य सिंचाई, हल्का N
✅ 3-4 सप्ताह: पूर्ण कार्यक्रम
rules.response_mr:
🔄 ताण रिकव्हरी:

✅ तात्काळ: कारण दूर करा
✅ 1-2 आठवडे: सामान्य पाणी, हलके N
✅ 3-4 आठवडे: पूर्ण कार्यक्रम
